description: SLO alert routing — maps a fired SLO error-budget breach to its delivery destination. An SLO with no route is an alert that can never reach an on-call engineer; the rehearsal in scripts/rehearse-alert-routing.mjs exits 1 on any unrouted SLO.

production_destination.channel: PagerDuty events API v2 (on-call rotation), broadcast to Slack #incidents
production_destination.delivery_contract: POST JSON event carrying slo_id, severity, error_budget_consumed_pct, fired_at and runbook; the destination acks with HTTP 200, anything else is a failed delivery. scripts/webhook-receiver.mjs enforces exactly this contract locally.
production_destination.rehearsal_note: In rehearsal the receiver URL below is a loopback webhook receiver (scripts/webhook-receiver.mjs). In production the same routing table points at the real destination — the rehearsal proves the route and the payload contract, not the destination's uptime.
